facts.text: Gina mentioned that a quote helped her stay positive during tough times, and she made a tattoo to remind herself of it.

evidence.quote: This quote kept me positive through tough times. We all need a push sometimes, right? Even made a tattoo to remind myself about it.
Got the tattoo a few years ago, it stands for freedom - dancing without worrying what people think.

facts.text: Jon expressed gratitude towards Gina for her support and mentioned that he is working on turning his dancing passion into a business.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Gina. Your help means a lot. I'll keep plugging away and stay optimistic.
Now, I'm aiming to turn my dancing passion into a business. I'm determined to make it work, I just know it!

facts.text: Jon asked Gina if she had just gotten her tattoo, indicating curiosity about the timing of the tattoo.

evidence.quote: Love the tattoo, did you just get it?
